Subject: Re: Petrichor security QA — technical prep and sample inventory

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for prioritizing. A few technical notes ahead of the call so we can move faster:

1) Data residency and telemetry
- Redwood's hosted inference defaults to region-specific deployments; telemetry and request routing are configurable per-customer. For your account we can ensure logs and telemetry remain in US regions only.

2) KMS / key ownership
- Private deployments: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault). Hosted customers can also opt into customer-managed keys for encrypted storage of model artifacts and logs.

3) Log samples & redaction
- What we can provide for initial review: auth events, inference request ID, timestamp, model_id (no prompt text), and token counts. We redact user-provided prompt text for hosted tiers by default.
- If you need unredacted traces for debug under an NDA, we can discuss scoped access and retention windows.

4) SOC2 timing
- We publish our last SOC2 Type II report on an annual cadence. The most recent report is available to customers under an NDA; Olga will cover the intake process on the call.

Attachments: I exported a short log-sample instruction sheet to guide what we can deliver and how to map fields. See redwood-log-sample-instructions.pdf (stub).

Action items for the call (we'll capture owners in the invite folder):
- Ben: share mutual-action-plan CSV in calendar folder (done)
- Alyssa: flag blocking CAIQ sections and confirm attendee list
- Petrichor: upload questionnaire v0.3 to Drive folder prior to call
- Redwood (Marissa/Olga): prepare example redacted logs + SOC2 intake checklist

Looking forward to it.
Marissa Cole | Security Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-log-sample-instructions.pdf (pdf/stub)

Thanks everyone — Wed 14:00 PT works. Attendees from Petrichor: Alyssa (SecOps), me (Procurement lead), and our platform engineer Samir Khan. A couple quick notes before the call:

- We'll need a secure upload link (S3 presigned or a secure SharePoint upload) for the SOC2 and log samples. Prefer S3 presigned with an expiry >7 days.
- SOC2: if Redwood can share the last Type II report ahead of the call under an NDA, that would significantly speed procurement.
- CAIQ: our procurement team will mark sections 2.1 (Data residency), 3.4 (KMS/keys), and 6.2 (Logging & monitoring) as blocking. Others are informative.

On the call we'll expect: short SOC2 intake steps, confirmation on KMS options, and an example of the redacted log sample format. If you can drop the Drive link and the upload instructions in the invite, we'll upload the completed v0.3 CAIQ before the meeting.

Appreciate it — see you Wednesday.
Ryan

Petrichor Therapeutics
